rationale: Per Maudsley 15th edition (Schizophrenia chapter, p.218). Male smokers have the highest CYP1A2 activity, requiring the highest maintenance target (375 mg/day) to achieve therapeutic plasma levels. Smoking induction must be considered: if the patient stops smoking during clozapine treatment, plasma levels can DOUBLE within 4 weeks — recheck level and reduce dose accordingly. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

steps.notes: First test dose 6.25 mg evening. Lying and standing BP at 1, 2 and 4 hours post-dose.
Counsel about hypersalivation, constipation. Start prophylactic laxative.
Hold a day if tolerability concerns.
Maintenance target reached. Critical: if patient stops smoking, plasma levels can rise sharply (up to 2× within 4 weeks). Check plasma level and reduce dose if needed.

postTitrationGuidance: Maintain at 375 mg/day. CRITICAL — smoking cessation post-titration: clozapine plasma levels can rise by up to 2× within 4 weeks. Recheck plasma level on smoking cessation and reduce dose accordingly. Plasma level optimisation target 350–600 ng/mL.
missedDoseRule: Doses missed for more than 48 hours mandate retitration. Use the Interruption Restart Wizard.
